data.title: Hurricane Polo (EP2), advisory 29/0553Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: POLO MAKES LANDFALL IN BAJA CALIFORNIA SUR JUST SOUTH OF LAS BARRANCAS. ...LIFE-THREATENING WINDS AND FLASH FLOODING ONGOING... As of 11:00 PM MST Mon Sep 28 the center of Polo was located near 25.9, -112.2 with movement NE at 13 mph. The minimum central pressure was 965 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 110 mph.

data.title: Tropical Storm Hanna (AT3), advisory 29/0839Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: HANNA HOLDS STEADY WHILE MAINTAINING AN EAST-SOUTHEAST TRACK. As of 5:00 AM AST Tue Sep 29 the center of Hanna was located near 35.2, -46.2 with movement ESE at 15 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1002 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 45 mph.

data.title: Tropical Storm Rachel (EP3), advisory 29/0846Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: RACHEL EXPECTED TO BECOME A HURRICANE DURING THE NEXT DAY OR SO. As of 3:00 AM CST Tue Sep 29 the center of Rachel was located near 14.7, -104.3 with movement WNW at 12 mph. The minimum central pressure was 992 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 60 mph.

data.title: Tropical Storm Fay (AT1), advisory 29/0849Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: FAY CONTINUES TO MOVE SOUTHWESTWARD OVER THE ATLANTIC OCEAN. As of 5:00 AM AST Tue Sep 29 the center of Fay was located near 25.0, -46.8 with movement SW at 13 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1008 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 40 mph.
